heading: The range.
intro: Every Lore product is made with GOTS-certified organic cotton. Fragrance free. Made in Europe.

day-pad.name: Medium Flow Pads
day-pad.description: Organic cotton pads for medium flow. 240mm, 10 per pack.
day-pad.howToUse: Peel off the release paper, place the pad in the middle of your underwear and fold the wings around. Change it every few hours, or more often on heavier days. Wrap the used pad in its wrapper and put it in the bin, never down the toilet.

night-pad.name: Heavy Flow Pads
night-pad.description: Longer organic cotton pads for heavy flow and overnight. 280mm, 10 per pack.
night-pad.howToUse: Peel off the release paper, place the pad in the middle of your underwear and fold the wings around. Change it every few hours, or more often on heavier days. Wrap the used pad in its wrapper and put it in the bin, never down the toilet.

liner.howToUse: Peel off the release paper and place the liner in the middle of your underwear. Change it whenever you like.

accordion.certificationBody: Our cotton is certified to the Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), which covers how it's grown and processed, including fair wages, safe working conditions and no child labor.
